description: This file contains classes that implement the compilation logic for the {if}, {else}, {elseif}, and {/if} tags in Smarty templates. It defines compile classes for these tags which generate PHP code to evaluate conditions and control flow in templates.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_If
classes.description: Handles compilation of the {if} tag, generating PHP code that evaluates the condition and initiates a conditional block.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Else
classes.description: Handles compilation of the {else} tag, closing the previous if/elseif block and starting an else block.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Elseif
classes.description: Handles compilation of the {elseif} tag, closing previous blocks and starting an elseif condition block.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Ifclose
classes.description: Handles compilation of the {/if} tag, closing all open if/elseif blocks.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Main method for compiling {if} tags, generating PHP conditional code based on attributes and parameters.
